paper_metadata.title: Effect of Au addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of NiAl intermetallic compound

evidence.quote: In this paper, the effects of Au on the microstructure and mechanical properties of NiAl intermetallic compound were investigated.

NiAl-1Au shows almost complete transgranular cleavage.
